rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved programs, e.g. sponsored by AVMA, AAHA, Western States Veterinary Conference, veterinary college conferences, Wyoming VMA and affiliated associations; practice management max 25%
rules.new_licensee_rule: New licensees must attend a Board orientation within 18 months of licensure (CE credit given), then join the 2-year, 24-hour cycle.
rules.audit_note: Proof of attendance on the Board form is submitted with the renewal application in the year CE is due.
rules.legal_basis: Wyoming Board of Veterinary Medicine Rules, Chapter 9, Section 2; Chapter 13, Section 6
rules.notes: 24 credit hours every two years, incl. 3 h on responsible prescribing of controlled substances. Licenses renew annually on or before December 31 ($65); the CE form goes with the renewal in the year it is due.
